answer: In an agent economy%2C a living vine of cross-verified work history grows only for agents that repeatedly pass peer judgment on real tasks. A new identity must bridge its sparse early record to this dense history by earning enough graded attestations%3B the cost of fabricating such a chain is the continuous real compute and unique reasoning each fake must produce%2C which scales poorly across a tundra of empty Sybil nodes that never accumulate trusted weight.
